name: Tax-Free Childcare account
description: Government tops up by 25p per £1 saved (max £500/quarter). Cannot use alongside UC childcare element.
eligibility_summary: For every £8 a parent pays into their account, the government adds £2 (up to £500 per child per quarter, or £1,000 if disabled). Must be in work and earning at least NMW for 16 hours.
